item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the dominance of the subtropical ridge, the weather will be persistently very hot and fine over southern China this week to early next week. A southerly airstream will bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 19/07 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly fine and very hot apart from isolated showers.
Temp range: 29 - 33 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
